ProjectBackup.title: ProjectBackup
ProjectBackup.description: Cloud backup snapshot of a RONIN STUDIO creative project stored under the owner's user account.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the project owner.

title.description: Display title of the backed-up project (1-100 chars).

projectType.description: Studio module type for the project.

sourceUpdatedAtMs.description: Local Room DB modification timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

onionSkin.description: Native map of onion skin configuration settings.

frames.description: Native list of animation/drawing frame maps with layers and strokes.

videoClips.description: Native list of video editor clip maps including trim, keyframes, and motion blur.

audioClips.description: Native list of sound studio audio clip maps.

framesCount.description: Total number of frames in the backup.

videoClipsCount.description: Total number of video clips in the backup.

audioClipsCount.description: Total number of audio clips in the backup.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest backup update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/project_backups/{project.description: Per-user isolated cloud backups for RONIN STUDIO projects.
